description:
You are a support engineer tasked with collecting basic system diagnostic information for troubleshooting purposes. Please generate a summary of the current free and used memory statistics on the system. 

To accomplish this, run a command that displays the memory usage in megabytes (MB), showing the total, used, and free memory, as well as swap memory statistics. 

Capture this information in a plain text file located at /home/user/memory_check.log. The log file must contain only the main memory statistics section from the command output (do NOT include extra summary lines or headers unrelated to memory and swap), and it should be in **tabular format** with columns: 

- total
- used
- free
- shared
- buff/cache
- available

Follow this format exactly:

```
              total        used        free      shared  buff/cache   available
Mem:      <total_MB>   <used_MB>   <free_MB>   <shared_MB>   <buff/cache_MB>   <available_MB>
Swap:     <total_MB>   <used_MB>   <free_MB>
```

Where `<total_MB>`, `<used_MB>`, etc. are the precise integer values as shown in the command output, aligned in columns. Ensure the log file contains only the header row and two rows (Mem: and Swap:), without any additional text or lines. 

When you are finished, review /home/user/memory_check.log to confirm it accurately matches the required format and contains up-to-date memory statistics.
